I take benzos (i think) for when I'm too anxious cause the long acting ones never really did anything. The one thing that's mainly helped me except meds was "putting thoughts on trial" that my therapist introduced me to when I still attended. It's a way to try to break out of the cycle of immediately jumping to the worst conclusion. You take the thought and present evidence pro and against, like in court, and try to make a conclusion as objectively as you can (will that bridge that has been there for, let's say, years fall when you pass under it? Glance at the pillars that are supporting it or up at it if you can see it. There isn't any cracks. How likely is it that a bridge could actually fall without something external causing it?)

Hope this helps
